title: My Paper Star
can_do: 遇到具体困难时，请求恰好够用的帮助，同时保留自己完成任务的机会。
trigger: The child wants to cut out a paper star but needs child-safe scissors and help turning the paper.
core_response: Can you help me get my child-safe scissors?
stretch_response: Can you help me turn the paper while I cut?
repair_response: No, help me turn it. I want to cut it.
setting: Making a paper star at the table.
essential_props: a paper star outline and child-safe scissors

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: You want to cut out this paper star. What do you need?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can you help me get my child-safe scissors?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Here they are. Should I cut the star for you?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: No, help me turn the paper while I cut.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I will hold the corner. You cut the last side.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It is a little wiggly, but it is still my star!

replay_cards.title: Open the lunch box
replay_cards.challenge: Ask Dad to hold the box while the child lifts the latch; the child opens it

replay_cards.title: Zip the coat
replay_cards.challenge: Ask Mom to hold the bottom while the child pulls the zipper up; the coat closes

parent_support: Name the child-safe scissors because retrieving them is part of the real task.
Offer the smallest useful help; do not take over the cutting unless safety requires it.
